notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 14036 (July 9, 2021, Promoting Competition in the American Economy) is revoked in full by EO 14337 (signed Aug. 13, 2025; 90 FR 40227, Aug. 19, 2025), whose Section 1 states that Executive Order 14036 of July 9, 2021 (Promoting Competition in the American Economy), is hereby revoked. The order has no own-terms end for the whole order, no earlier order revokes it, and EO 14337 Sec. 2 preserves only agency authorities granted by law and OMB functions, not any command of EO 14036. Partial scope: the revocation is of the entire order. Savings: no continuing command of EO 14036 is preserved. The status is no as of 2026-10-14; EO 14337 is the formal disposition and is offered here only as the whole-order bound, not as the first end of each of the 132 clauses, so the lifecycle claim is blocked.
